description_en: Modifies the watermark for a gateway file share
description_zh: 调整网关文件共享淘汰水位
kebab_example: aliyun sgw modify-gateway-file-share-watermark --gateway-id gw-0001xv7je35800310000 --index-id NFSalex0000 --watermark 40 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyGatewayFileShareWatermark

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file share. You can obtain the ID by calling the DescribeGatewayFileShares operation
parameters.help_zh: 文件共享ID。可以通过DescribeGatewayFileShares接口获得
parameters.name: index_id

parameters.help_en:
The watermark. The value must be within the following range:

Minimum value: 40.
Maximum value: 90
parameters.help_zh:
淘汰水位。取值范围如下：
最小值：40。
最大值：90
parameters.name: watermark
